name: subscription_name
description: Name of the Pub/Sub subscription that delivered the message.

name: message_id
description: Unique identifier assigned to the message by Pub/Sub.

name: publish_time
description: Timestamp when the message was published to the Pub/Sub topic.

name: attributes
description: Pub/Sub message attributes, including any diagnostic metadata such as udf_error.

name: insertId
description: Unique identifier for the log entry assigned by Cloud Logging.

name: logName
description: Resource name of the log to which this log entry belongs.

name: timestamp
description: Timestamp of the event described by the log entry (used for daily table partitioning).

name: receiveTimestamp
description: Timestamp when the log entry was received by the Cloud Logging API.

name: severity
description: Severity level of the log entry (e.g., DEFAULT, DEBUG, INFO, NOTICE, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL, ALERT, EMERGENCY).

name: textPayload
description: Plain-text log entry payload representation.

name: jsonPayload
description: Structured JSON log payload stringified by the Pub/Sub inline SMT JavaScript UDF.

name: protoPayload
description: Protocol buffer audit or system payload serialized into JSON by the Pub/Sub inline SMT JavaScript UDF.

name: resource
description: Monitored resource that produced the log entry.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Monitored resource type identifier (e.g., gce_instance, k8s_container, cloud_run_revision).

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Dynamic monitored resource labels stringified into JSON by the inline SMT UDF.

name: labels
description: User-defined and system key-value labels associated with the log entry, stored as native JSON.

name: httpRequest
description: Information about the HTTP request associated with this log entry, if applicable.

fields.name: requestMethod
fields.description: HTTP request method (e.g., GET, POST, PUT, DELETE).

fields.name: requestUrl
fields.description: Requested URL including scheme, host, path, and query parameters.

fields.name: requestSize
fields.description: Size of the HTTP request message in bytes, including headers and body.

fields.name: status
fields.description: HTTP response status code (e.g., 200, 404, 500).

fields.name: responseSize
fields.description: Size of the HTTP response message sent back to the client in bytes.

fields.name: userAgent
fields.description: User-Agent header sent by the HTTP client.

fields.name: remoteIp
fields.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) of the client that issued the HTTP request.

fields.name: serverIp
fields.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) of the origin server that handled the request.

fields.name: referer
fields.description: Referer URL header value of the HTTP request.

fields.name: latency
fields.description: Processing latency on the server, formatted in seconds (e.g., '0.124s').

fields.name: cacheLookup
fields.description: True if a cache lookup was performed for this HTTP request.

fields.name: cacheHit
fields.description: True if the HTTP response was served directly from an edge or CDN cache.

fields.name: cacheValidatedWithOriginServer
fields.description: True if the cached entry was validated with the origin server before serving.

fields.name: cacheFillBytes
fields.description: Number of bytes inserted into the cache as a result of this request.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Network protocol used for the request (e.g., HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3).

name: operation
description: Information about a long-running operation or grouped execution context.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the operation across related log entries.

fields.name: producer
fields.description: Identifier of the service or subsystem producing the operation.

fields.name: first
fields.description: True if this log entry is the first entry in the operation.

fields.name: last
fields.description: True if this log entry is the final entry in the operation.

name: trace
description: Cloud Trace resource name associated with the log entry (projects/{PROJECT_ID}/traces/{TRACE_ID}).

name: spanId
description: Span ID within the Cloud Trace for distributed request correlation.

name: traceSampled
description: True if the trace associated with this log entry was sampled for storage.

name: sourceLocation
description: Source code location information where the log entry was generated.

fields.name: file
fields.description: Source file path or module name.

fields.name: line
fields.description: Line number within the source file.

fields.name: function
fields.description: Name of the function or method that invoked the logger.
